page.overview:
Who is Faregame?

"(To Lightning McQueen) Hey buddy, GET THE **HONK** OUT OF MY WAY!!!!!"{{Character

Faregame is an irate goldenrod taxi who takes part in the demolition derby at the Thunder Hollow Speedway, and is one of the minor characters in Cars 3.

He got eliminated after Taco hit him from behind, causing him to fly forwards and get stuck in the back of Dr. Damage, who loses control and hits a wall, leaving him eliminated as well.

Faregame is a goldenrod livery resembling a taxi with light pea green eyes, a gunmetal mouth with looks like a "metal beard", and checker stripes and a top of the head with the same as the texture of the stripes. Faregame also has the number "42" on each side. There is also charcoal-colored duct tape seen on the "nose" and the white wheels.
